name: Noble Leaders
game_text:
When you play this condition, place a <culture>Gondor</culture> token here for each of the following characters you can spot: Aragorn, Boromir, Denethor or Faramir.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Remove a token from here or discard this condition to make a <culture>Gondor</culture> companion strength +1 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword>.
